title: Figures of Speech
content: DefinitionEnglish: Figures of speech are words or phrases used in a non-literal way to create an effect or emphasize ideas.Hindi: Alankar ya vakya shaili shabd ya vakyansh hote hain jo gair-shabdik roop se prayog kiye jate hain taaki prabhav ya vichar ko rochak banaya jaye.They enhance language by adding beauty, emotion, or clarity.Ye bhasha ko sundar, bhavuk, ya spasht banate hain.Example: Her smile is like the sun.Hindi: Uski muskaan suraj jaisi hai.

title: Simile
content: DefinitionEnglish: A comparison between two unlike things using 'like' or 'as'.Hindi: Do alag cheezon ki tulna 'jaisa' ya 'ke samaan' shabdon ke saath.UseTo make descriptions vivid and relatable.Varnan ko jeevant aur saral banane ke liye.Example: He runs like the wind.Hindi: Woh hawa ke jaisa daudta hai.

title: Metaphor
content: DefinitionEnglish: A direct comparison between two unlike things without using 'like' or 'as'.Hindi: Do alag cheezon ki sidhi tulna bina 'jaisa' ya 'ke samaan' ke.UseTo create a strong, imaginative image.Prabhavshali aur kalpanik chhavi banane ke liye.Example: Time is a thief.Hindi: Samay ek chor hai.

title: Personification
content: DefinitionEnglish: Giving human qualities to non-human things.Hindi: Gair-manav cheezon ko manaviy gun dena.UseTo make inanimate objects relatable or lively.Nirjeev vastuon ko jeevant ya samajhne yogya banane ke liye.Example: The flowers danced in the breeze.Hindi: Phool hawa mein nache.

title: Hyperbole
content: DefinitionEnglish: An exaggerated statement not meant to be taken literally.Hindi: Ati-vyaktigat vaktavya jo shabdik roop se nahi liya jata.UseTo emphasize a point or add humor.Kisi baat par zor dene ya hasya jodne ke liye.Example: I’m so hungry I could eat a horse.Hindi: Mujhe itni bhookh hai ki main ek ghoda kha sakta hoon.

title: Alliteration
content: DefinitionEnglish: Repetition of the same sound or letter at the beginning of closely connected words.Hindi: Ek hi swar ya akshar ka pas-pas ke shabdon mein dohraav.UseTo create rhythm or emphasize words.Laya ya shabdon par zor dene ke liye.Example: Peter Piper picked a peck of pickled peppers.Hindi: Shyam sundar ne sabun churaya.

title: Onomatopoeia
content: DefinitionEnglish: Words that imitate the sound they describe.Hindi: Shabd jo us awaaz ki nakal karte hain jo wo varnan karte hain.UseTo make descriptions more vivid by mimicking sounds.Awaaz ki nakal karke varnan ko jeevant banane ke liye.Example: The bees buzzed loudly.Hindi: Bhanwre bhinbhinaye.

title: Oxymoron
content: DefinitionEnglish: A phrase combining two contradictory terms.Hindi: Do virodhi shabdon ka ek saath prayog.UseTo create a dramatic or thought-provoking effect.Natakiy ya vichar-prerak prabhav banane ke liye.Example: The silence was deafening.Hindi: Sannata bahut chubhnewala tha.

title: Irony
content: DefinitionEnglish: A contrast between expectation and reality, often with a humorous or sarcastic effect.Hindi: Ummeed aur vastavikta ke beech ka virodh, aksar hasyaprad ya vyangyatmak prabhav ke saath.UseTo highlight contradictions or mock gently.Virodh ko ujaagar karne ya halke se mazak udane ke liye.Example: A fire station burned down.Hindi: Agni shman kendra jal gaya.
